$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the run made the publish job wait for the release evaluation job and limited that job to pull requests, so on a published release the evaluation job is skipped and the publish job, which needs it, is skipped with it. The wait is present as text and the shipment never happens.
The file is the live capture (evaluation-gate-live-capture) with the evaluation-release job's guard changed from release to pull_request.
derivation: The file parses and actionlint reports nothing. The evaluation-release job runs on pull_request where release belongs, so the job element misses, and the publish job that needs it runs on no event, so the wait element misses; every other element is present, nothing is unrequested and no rule is violated.

elementMisses: job-evaluation-release: job evaluation-release runs on pull_request, expected release
wait-publish: job publish runs on no event, expected release
